how: Each large dot is one biological unit: the amount of ODC1 divided by the mean of its control genes (ALUsq(Eurogentec), HMBS, HPRT1, SDHA(1), UBC(2)), from each well's curve and efficiency, shown relative to the mean of rest.
Each unit has one well for this gene.
The bar is each group's mean and the band its 95 % confidence interval, from the units' values (not the wells).
